items.reason: Randomized rater-blinded phase III early palliative-care trial in newly diagnosed or recurrent glioblastoma within four weeks of diagnosis; 231 enrolled, 109 vs 108 randomized, intervention delivered for 12 months. Primary endpoint FACT-Br Trial Outcome Index change at 6 months was not significant (mITT n=98 vs 89; difference 4.1, 95% CI −4.4 to 12.6; P=.34). Median OS was 14 vs 21 months; HR for death 1.56 (95% CI 1.07–2.27; P=.018), favouring control. Secondary patient QoL, mood and palliative symptom burden improved in several analyses; caregivers did not show benefit. Adverse events were not assessed in this non-AMG/non-MPG trial. Important contrary evidence; interpret the survival imbalance cautiously given limitations and post-hoc time-of-death analyses.
items.action: Retain in the palliative/supportive-care contrary-evidence queue; do not convert into a positive early-palliative-care standard. Preserve the primary null QoL result and the survival signal together.
items.status_note: Full primary article and DRKS registry identifier verified; no NNT because the primary endpoint is continuous QoL and survival is time-to-event.

items.reason: New-to-Atlas phase III perioperative gastric/GEJ study with primary final analysis and recent FLOT-cohort follow-up. Main cohort final analysis (n=804; FLOT cohort n=203) at median follow-up 59.9 months: median OS 71.8 vs 55.7 months, HR 0.86 (95% CI 0.71–1.06); EFS HR 0.81 (95% CI 0.67–0.98); grade ≥3 drug-related AEs 65% vs 63%; HRQoL not worsened. The 203-patient FLOT cohort was a safety cohort with exploratory, non-powered efficacy: pCR 17.0% vs 6.8% (difference 10.2 pp, 95% CI 1.3–19.7); EFS HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.50–1.13); OS HR 0.81 (95% CI 0.53–1.25). The primary OS comparison was not statistically significant and the FLOT cohort cannot establish efficacy. Defer pending exact current guideline context; do not create a separate page for the FLOT follow-up.
items.action: Retain the primary final analysis and FLOT cohort paper together as one underlying study; map exact guideline provenance only if the current NCCN/ESMO recommendation and citation are accessible.
